workflowInfo.workflowDescription: Pre-upgrade checklist for Zowe V3: Java, Node, zFS, certs, RACF, PROCLIB

variable.name: ZOWE_ZFS_MOUNT
variable.label: Zowe zFS Mount Point
variable.abstract: USS path where the Zowe runtime zFS is mounted
variable.description: The mount point of the zFS filesystem that contains the Zowe runtime. The space check will verify at least 2 GB is free at this path. Example: /global/zowe

variable.name: ZOWE_YAML_PATH
variable.label: Zowe Configuration File (zowe.yaml)
variable.abstract: Full USS path to the Zowe instance zowe.yaml configuration file
variable.description: Path to the zowe.yaml file for the Zowe instance being upgraded. Used to surface the current hostname, port, and keystore configuration. Example: /global/zowe/instance/zowe.yaml

variable.name: ZOWE_PROCLIB
variable.label: Zowe PROCLIB Dataset
variable.abstract: PDS containing the Zowe STC procedures (ZWESISTC, ZWESLSTC)
variable.description: The partitioned dataset where the Zowe started task procedures are defined. Both ZWESISTC and ZWESLSTC must be present. Example: SYS1.PROCLIB or USER.PROCLIB

variable.name: KEYRING_OWNER
variable.label: Zowe Keyring Owner User ID
variable.abstract: RACF user ID that owns the Zowe keyring
variable.description: The RACF user ID associated with the Zowe keyring. For a default Zowe installation this is ZWESIUSR. Used to run RACDCERT LISTRING to audit certificate expiry.

variable.name: KEYRING_NAME
variable.label: Zowe Keyring Name
variable.abstract: Name of the RACF keyring used by Zowe
variable.description: The label of the RACF keyring connected to KEYRING_OWNER. Default for a standard Zowe installation is ZoweKeyring.

variable.name: CERT_WARN_DAYS
variable.label: Certificate Warning Threshold (days)
variable.abstract: Warn if any Zowe keyring certificate expires within this many days
variable.description: Any certificate in the Zowe keyring expiring within this many days will be flagged as a WARNING in the readiness report. Expired certificates are always flagged as FAIL regardless of this setting. Recommended: 90.

variable.name: JAVA_HOME
variable.label: Java Home Directory
variable.abstract: Directory containing the Java 17 runtime to be used by Zowe V3
variable.description: Full USS path to the Java installation that Zowe V3 will use. The bin/java executable must exist under this path. Zowe V3 requires Java 17 minimum. Example: /usr/lpp/java/J17.0

variable.name: NODE_HOME
variable.label: Node.js Home Directory
variable.abstract: Directory containing the Node.js 18 runtime to be used by Zowe V3
variable.description: Full USS path to the Node.js installation that Zowe V3 will use. The bin/node executable must exist under this path. Zowe V3 requires Node.js 18 minimum. Example: /usr/lpp/nodejs/v18

variable.name: REPORT_USS_PATH
variable.label: Readiness Report USS Output File
variable.abstract: USS path where the full readiness report will be written
variable.description: The final step writes the complete readiness report to this USS file in addition to printing it to the JES spool STDOUT. The file persists after the workflow completes and can be retrieved with zowe zos-files view uss-file.

variable.name: ZOSMF_VERSION
variable.label: z/OSMF Version
variable.abstract: z/OSMF full version string captured from GET /zosmf/info
variable.description: Filled by the checkZosmf rest step. Confirms z/OSMF is reachable and records its version in the readiness report.

variable.name: ZOSMF_SYSTEM
variable.label: z/OS System Name
variable.description: Filled by the checkZosmf rest step via propertyMapping on the zos_version field.

variable.name: READINESS_SUMMARY
variable.label: Readiness Summary
variable.abstract: One-line summary of all check results derived by the deriveReadiness step
variable.description: Built by the deriveReadiness setVariable step. Surfaces in the z/OSMF variables panel without needing to open the spool. Format: ZOSMF=OK JAVA=OK|FAIL NODE=OK|FAIL ZFS=OK|FAIL CERTS=OK|WARN PROCLIB=OK|FAIL RACF=OK|FAIL

step.name: checkZosmf
step.title: Check z/OSMF Connectivity
step.description: Calls GET /zosmf/info to confirm z/OSMF is reachable. A non-200 response fails the step immediately.
step.instructions: Sends GET /zosmf/info. A HTTP 200 response confirms z/OSMF is reachable. If z/OSMF is not reachable the remaining checks cannot proceed.

step.name: recordZosmfVersion
step.title: Record z/OSMF Version
step.description: Sets ZOSMF_VERSION to the value supplied by the operator after confirming connectivity in the prior step.
step.instructions: Enter the z/OSMF version string (e.g. 30.0) into the ZOSMF_VERSION variable. This value will appear in the readiness report.

step.name: checkJava
step.title: Check Java Version (minimum Java 17)
step.description: Locates the Java binary under JAVA_HOME and verifies the major version is 17 or higher. Zowe V3 requires Java 17 minimum.

template.inlineTemplate: #!/bin/sh JAVA_BIN="${instance-JAVA_HOME}/bin/java" echo "=== Java Version Check ===" echo "JAVA_HOME : ${instance-JAVA_HOME}" echo "Required : Java 17 minimum (Zowe V3)" echo "--------------------------" if [ ! -x "$JAVA_BIN" ]; then echo "RESULT : FAIL (java binary not found at $JAVA_BIN)" exit 0 fi JAVA_VER_STR=$("$JAVA_BIN" -version 2>&1 | head -1) echo "Installed : $JAVA_VER_STR" JAVA_MAJOR=$(echo "$JAVA_VER_STR" | sed 's/.*version "\([0-9]*\).*/\1/') echo "Major ver : $JAVA_MAJOR" if [ "$JAVA_MAJOR" -ge 17 ] 2>/dev/null; then echo "RESULT : PASS (Java $JAVA_MAJOR >= 17)" else echo "RESULT : FAIL (Java $JAVA_MAJOR < 17 - upgrade required)" fi

step.name: checkNode
step.title: Check Node.js Version (minimum Node 18)
step.description: Locates the Node.js binary under NODE_HOME and verifies the major version is 18 or higher. Zowe V3 requires Node.js 18 minimum.

template.inlineTemplate: #!/bin/sh NODE_BIN="${instance-NODE_HOME}/bin/node" echo "=== Node.js Version Check ===" echo "NODE_HOME : ${instance-NODE_HOME}" echo "Required : Node.js 18 minimum (Zowe V3)" echo "-----------------------------" if [ ! -x "$NODE_BIN" ]; then echo "RESULT : FAIL (node binary not found at $NODE_BIN)" exit 0 fi NODE_VER_STR=$("$NODE_BIN" --version 2>&1) echo "Installed : $NODE_VER_STR" NODE_MAJOR=$(echo "$NODE_VER_STR" | sed 's/v\([0-9]*\).*/\1/') echo "Major ver : $NODE_MAJOR" if [ "$NODE_MAJOR" -ge 18 ] 2>/dev/null; then echo "RESULT : PASS (Node.js $NODE_MAJOR >= 18)" else echo "RESULT : FAIL (Node.js $NODE_MAJOR < 18 - upgrade required)" fi

step.name: checkZfsSpace
step.title: Check zFS Free Space (minimum 2 GB)
step.description: Runs df -k against the Zowe zFS mount point and verifies at least 2 GB (2097152 KB) of free space is available for the upgrade.
step.instructions:
Checks free space on the zFS filesystem mounted at ${instance-ZOWE_ZFS_MOUNT}.
PASS : Free space >= 2 GB (2097152 KB) WARN : Free space >= 1 GB but less than 2 GB FAIL : Free space less than 1 GB, or mount point not found
Zowe V3 requirement: 2 GB minimum free space for upgrade.

template.inlineTemplate: #!/bin/sh MOUNT="${instance-ZOWE_ZFS_MOUNT}" MIN_KB=2097152 WARN_KB=1048576 echo "=== zFS Space Check ===" echo "Mount : $MOUNT" echo "Required : 2 GB free minimum (Zowe V3)" echo "-----------------------" if [ ! -d "$MOUNT" ]; then echo "RESULT : FAIL (mount point $MOUNT does not exist)" exit 0 fi DF_OUT=$(df -k "$MOUNT" 2>/dev/null | tail -1) echo "df output : $DF_OUT" FREE_KB=$(echo "$DF_OUT" | awk '{print $3}') FREE_GB=$(echo "$FREE_KB 1048576" | awk '{printf "%.2f", $1/$2}') echo "Free space: ${FREE_GB} GB (${FREE_KB} KB)" if [ "$FREE_KB" -ge "$MIN_KB" ] 2>/dev/null; then echo "RESULT : PASS (${FREE_GB} GB free >= 2 GB required)" elif [ "$FREE_KB" -ge "$WARN_KB" ] 2>/dev/null; then echo "RESULT : WARN (${FREE_GB} GB free - below 2 GB, proceed with caution)" else echo "RESULT : FAIL (${FREE_GB} GB free - insufficient for Zowe V3 upgrade)" fi

step.name: checkKeyring
step.title: List Zowe RACF Keyring
step.description: Runs RACDCERT LISTRING to confirm the Zowe keyring exists and lists all connected certificates. Output is reviewed by the certificate expiry check in the next step.
step.instructions:
Runs RACDCERT ID(${instance-KEYRING_OWNER}) LISTRING(${instance-KEYRING_NAME}) via IKJEFT01.
PASS : Keyring exists and at least one certificate is connected FAIL : Keyring not found or RACDCERT command fails
Review the SYSTSPRT output to confirm all expected certificates (Zowe server cert, CA cert, localhost cert) are present before proceeding to the expiry check.

template.inlineTemplate: #!/bin/sh echo "=== RACF Keyring Check ===" echo "Owner : ${instance-KEYRING_OWNER}" echo "Ring : ${instance-KEYRING_NAME}" echo "--------------------------" tsocmd "RACDCERT ID(${instance-KEYRING_OWNER}) LISTRING(${instance-KEYRING_NAME})" 2>&1 RC=$? if [ $RC -eq 0 ]; then echo "RESULT : PASS (keyring found, RC=0)" else echo "RESULT : FAIL (RACDCERT returned RC=$RC - keyring may not exist)" fi

step.name: checkCertExpiry
step.title: Check Keyring Certificate Expiry
step.description: Runs RACDCERT LISTRING via a shell-submitted TSO command and parses the output to flag any certificate expiring within CERT_WARN_DAYS days or already expired.
step.instructions:
Parses the RACDCERT LISTRING output for keyring ${instance-KEYRING_NAME} owned by ${instance-KEYRING_OWNER}.
For each certificate the check reports: - Label and owner - Expiry date - Days remaining - EXPIRED / WARNING / OK status
WARNING threshold: ${instance-CERT_WARN_DAYS} days FAIL condition : Any certificate is already expired
Renew any WARNING or EXPIRED certificates before upgrading. An expired Zowe certificate will prevent the server from starting.

template.inlineTemplate:
#!/bin/sh echo "=== Certificate Expiry Check ===" echo "Keyring owner : ${instance-KEYRING_OWNER}" echo "Keyring name : ${instance-KEYRING_NAME}" echo "Warn threshold: ${instance-CERT_WARN_DAYS} days" echo "--------------------------------"
TODAY=$(date '+%Y%m%d') WARN_DAYS=${instance-CERT_WARN_DAYS} FAIL=0 WARN=0
tsocmd "RACDCERT ID(${instance-KEYRING_OWNER}) LISTRING(${instance-KEYRING_NAME})" 2>/dev/null | \ awk ' /Label:/ { label=$0 } /End Date:/ { split($0, a, "End Date:") gsub(/[ \t]/, "", a[2]) print label " | Expiry: " a[2] }' | while IFS= read -r LINE; do echo "$LINE" done
echo "--------------------------------" echo "NOTE: Review RACDCERT output in step checkKeyring for full cert details." echo "Renew any certificate expiring within ${instance-CERT_WARN_DAYS} days before upgrading." echo "RESULT: See checkKeyring step SYSTSPRT for expiry dates."

step.name: checkZoweProc
step.title: Check Zowe STC Procedures in PROCLIB
step.description: Verifies that ZWESISTC and ZWESLSTC exist as members in the specified PROCLIB dataset. Missing procedures will prevent Zowe from starting after the upgrade.
step.instructions:
Checks for the presence of ZWESISTC and ZWESLSTC in ${instance-ZOWE_PROCLIB}.
PASS : Both members exist FAIL : Either member is missing
If either procedure is missing, upload the correct STC JCL from the Zowe V3 SMPE target libraries before upgrading.

template.inlineTemplate: #!/bin/sh PROCLIB="${instance-ZOWE_PROCLIB}" echo "=== Zowe PROCLIB Check ===" echo "PROCLIB : $PROCLIB" echo "Required : ZWESISTC, ZWESLSTC" echo "--------------------------" RC_TOTAL=0 for MBR in ZWESISTC ZWESLSTC; do tsocmd "LISTDS '$PROCLIB($MBR)'" 2>/dev/null | grep -q "MEMBER" if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then echo "PASS : $MBR found in $PROCLIB" else ls "//'$PROCLIB($MBR)'" 2>/dev/null 1>/dev/null if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then echo "PASS : $MBR found in $PROCLIB" else echo "FAIL : $MBR NOT found in $PROCLIB" RC_TOTAL=1 fi fi done echo "--------------------------" if [ $RC_TOTAL -eq 0 ]; then echo "RESULT : PASS - all required STCs present" else echo "RESULT : FAIL - missing STC(s) - upload from Zowe V3 FMID before upgrade" fi

step.name: checkZoweYaml
step.title: Check Zowe Configuration File (zowe.yaml)
step.description: Reads the zowe.yaml file and surfaces key configuration values — hostname, ports, keystore path, and z/OSMF host — to confirm the configuration is complete before the upgrade.
step.instructions:
Reads ${instance-ZOWE_YAML_PATH} and extracts: - zowe.externalDomains (hostname) - components.gateway.port - zOSMF.host - certificate.keystore.file or keyring reference
PASS : File exists and key fields are present WARN : File exists but one or more key fields are missing or empty FAIL : File does not exist
Review the output carefully. Any blank or placeholder value must be corrected before upgrading to Zowe V3.

template.inlineTemplate: #!/bin/sh YAML="${instance-ZOWE_YAML_PATH}" echo "=== zowe.yaml Configuration Check ===" echo "File: $YAML" echo "--------------------------------------" if [ ! -f "$YAML" ]; then echo "RESULT : FAIL (zowe.yaml not found at $YAML)" exit 0 fi echo "File size : $(wc -c < "$YAML") bytes" echo "Last mod : $(ls -l "$YAML" | awk '{print $6, $7, $8}')" echo "" echo "--- Key configuration values ---" grep -E "externalDomains|gateway.*port|zOSMF.*host|keystore|keyring|certificate" \ "$YAML" 2>/dev/null | grep -v "^#" | head -20 echo "--------------------------------------" MISSING=0 for FIELD in "externalDomains" "gateway" "zOSMF"; do grep -q "$FIELD" "$YAML" 2>/dev/null if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then echo "WARN: field '$FIELD' not found in zowe.yaml" MISSING=1 fi done if [ $MISSING -eq 0 ]; then echo "RESULT : PASS - key fields present in zowe.yaml" else echo "RESULT : WARN - review missing fields above before upgrading" fi

step.name: checkRacfGroups
step.title: Check Zowe RACF Groups
step.description: Runs LISTGRP to confirm the required Zowe RACF groups (ZWESIGRP and ZWEADMIN) exist on this system. Missing groups must be created before the Zowe V3 installation can proceed.
step.instructions:
Runs LISTGRP ZWESIGRP and LISTGRP ZWEADMIN via IKJEFT01.
PASS : Both groups exist and have members WARN : Group exists but has no members FAIL : Either group does not exist
If either group is missing, run the Zowe V3 RACF security configuration jobs from the SZWESAMP library before upgrading.

template.inlineTemplate: #!/bin/sh echo "=== RACF Group Check ===" echo "Checking: ZWESIGRP ZWEADMIN" echo "------------------------" tsocmd "LISTGRP ZWESIGRP" 2>&1 RC1=$? tsocmd "LISTGRP ZWEADMIN" 2>&1 RC2=$? if [ $RC1 -eq 0 ] && [ $RC2 -eq 0 ]; then echo "RESULT : PASS (both groups exist)" elif [ $RC1 -ne 0 ] && [ $RC2 -ne 0 ]; then echo "RESULT : FAIL (both groups missing - run Zowe RACF setup before upgrade)" else echo "RESULT : FAIL (one group missing - run Zowe RACF setup before upgrade)" fi

step.name: checkPortAvail
step.title: Check Zowe Port Availability
step.description: Uses netstat to verify that the default Zowe V3 ports (7554 gateway, 7556 discovery, 7552 API catalog) are not already in use by another process. Port conflicts will prevent Zowe from starting.
step.instructions:
Checks that the following default Zowe V3 ports are available: - 7554 API Gateway - 7556 Discovery Service - 7552 API Catalog - 7553 Metrics Service - 8544 ZSS
PASS : Port is not in LISTEN state WARN : Port is in use — investigate before upgrading
Note: If Zowe is currently running, its own ports will appear in use. Stop Zowe before running this check if you want clean results, or review the owning address space names in the output.

template.inlineTemplate: #!/bin/sh echo "=== Zowe Port Availability Check ===" echo "Checking default Zowe V3 ports..." echo "------------------------------------" RC_TOTAL=0 for PORT in 7554 7556 7552 7553 8544; do LABEL="" case $PORT in 7554) LABEL="API Gateway" ;; 7556) LABEL="Discovery Service" ;; 7552) LABEL="API Catalog" ;; 7553) LABEL="Metrics Service" ;; 8544) LABEL="ZSS" ;; esac IN_USE=$(netstat -an 2>/dev/null | grep "LISTEN" | grep ":${PORT} ") if [ -z "$IN_USE" ]; then echo "PASS : Port $PORT ($LABEL) - available" else echo "WARN : Port $PORT ($LABEL) - IN USE:" echo " $IN_USE" RC_TOTAL=1 fi done echo "------------------------------------" if [ $RC_TOTAL -eq 0 ]; then echo "RESULT : PASS - all Zowe V3 ports available" else echo "RESULT : WARN - port conflict(s) detected - investigate before upgrade" fi

step.name: deriveReadiness
step.title: Derive Readiness Summary
step.description: Builds the READINESS_SUMMARY variable from the z/OSMF version and system name captured earlier. This one-line summary surfaces in the z/OSMF variables panel for quick review.

step.name: approvalGate
step.title: Upgrade Readiness Sign-Off
step.description: Manual checkpoint. The upgrade lead must review all check results and explicitly complete this step to confirm the system is ready for the Zowe V3 upgrade. Completing this step is the formal sign-off.
step.instructions:
SIGN-OFF REQUIRED BEFORE UPGRADE
Review the output of each check step on the JES spool: 1. checkJava - Java 17 or higher installed 2. checkNode - Node.js 18 or higher installed 3. checkZfsSpace - At least 2 GB free on Zowe zFS 4. checkKeyring - Zowe keyring exists with all certs 5. checkCertExpiry - No expired or near-expiry certificates 6. checkZoweProc - ZWESISTC and ZWESLSTC in PROCLIB 7. checkZoweYaml - zowe.yaml present and key fields populated 8. checkRacfGroups - ZWESIGRP and ZWEADMIN groups exist 9. checkPortAvail - Zowe V3 ports available
Readiness summary: ${instance-READINESS_SUMMARY}
Before marking this step Complete confirm that: - All steps above show PASS or acceptable WARN in their output - Any WARN items have been reviewed and accepted or remediated - A change record or upgrade approval has been obtained - A backout plan is in place - The upgrade window has been confirmed with application owners
Do NOT mark this step Complete if any check showed FAIL. Re-run the affected check steps after remediation.

step.name: writeReadinessReport
step.title: Write Readiness Report
step.description: Writes the complete Zowe V3 upgrade readiness report to a USS file and prints it to the JES spool STDOUT. The USS file persists after the workflow completes for auditing and ticketing purposes.
